meta.title: Competitor Radar
meta.niche: AI-powered video and image generation software (text-to-video, image-to-video, generative creative tools)

analysis.summary: Runway and HeyGen publish the most. Both push AI video into agents and chat tools, while Pika and Luma publish little and Kling AI shows no pages.

points.text: Runway ships 17 new pages, mostly product and landing pages, while HeyGen balances launches with 5 Academy-style how-tos and 3 case studies.
Runway, Pika and HeyGen all tie their video tools to chat and agent apps like ChatGPT, Claude and Manus.
Kling 4.0 is a hot topic: Runway has a full launch page, while Pika only has a coming-soon page.

Runway.play: Launches ads, agent, App Studio and Kling 4.0 pages, plus filmmaker and UGC guides.

Pika.play: Pushes its new H3 Flex model, image studio and ChatGPT app with a technical deep dive.

Luma AI.play: Publishes little: an About page, a learning center update and one research paper.

Kling AI.play: No pages found on the site in this data, so no content play to read.

HeyGen.play: Avatars, translation and developer API, backed by Academy tutorials, case studies and 130 tool pages.

shared.title: Video inside AI assistants
shared.text: Runway has MCP for ChatGPT, Claude and Cursor, plus a Claude Marketplace post. Pika launched inside ChatGPT. HeyGen has a Manus page. Chat apps are becoming a distribution channel.

shared.title: Kling 4.0 pages
shared.text: Runway has a launch page for Kling 4.0 with 30-second video. Pika has a coming-soon page. Both want searchers looking for that model.

shared.title: Research as credibility
shared.text: Runway has 1 research page, HeyGen has 2 updated ones, and Luma has its MARBLE paper. Small numbers, but it signals technical depth.

gaps.title: Step-by-step academy for filmmakers
gaps.text: HeyGen runs a tutorial series on translation. No rival has a multi-part course on cinematic AI video workflows. Runway has only 6 how-tos.

gaps.title: Customer case studies
gaps.text: HeyGen has 3 new case studies and Runway has none. Pika and Luma have none. Filmmaker and brand stories could show real results.

gaps.title: Model comparison pages
gaps.text: Only 1 Runway page targets comparing, and rivals have none. Honest head-to-head guides could reach people choosing between platforms.

versus.Pika: Pika publishes far less (5 new pages vs 17) and focuses on its own model launches, without Runway's guides or marketing use cases.
versus.Luma AI: Luma publishes very little (2 new pages) and leans on learning and research, with no launch or buyer pages like Runway's.
versus.Kling AI: No pages appear in the data, so there is nothing to compare, though Runway and Pika both publish Kling 4.0 pages.
versus.HeyGen: HeyGen publishes at similar pace (16 new pages) but leans harder on tutorials, case studies, industry pages and updates, where Runway leans on launches.
